extra.summary: DBS Woman’s World Card is a great rewards and air miles credit card for ladies and men. Benefits include an attractive 10X Points program for online spend, annual fee waiver, Agoda staycation deals, and other promotions. DBS Points earned can be redeemed for miles, AirPods via the DBS Rewards Apple Store, cash back, and more.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.80% p.a. chargeable on daily basis (subject to compounding)

our_takes.our-take: Our Take: For online shopping enthusiasts, the DBS Woman's World Card offers a lucrative 10X DBS Points (4 miles per S$1) on online purchases, maximizing rewards on everyday e-commerce. While marketed towards women, both men and women can benefit if you spend a lot online. Note the S$80,000 minimum income requirement. Optimize your earnings by strategically using this card for online transactions, particularly in categories like fashion and beauty. Consider that points exclusions may apply.
our_takes.good-for:
Online shoppers seeking accelerated rewards on e-commerce purchases, especially in fashion and beauty categories.
Air miles enthusiasts who want to maximise miles earned on online and overseas spending.
Singaporeans earning at least S$80,000 annually and want extra e-commerce protection on their online purchases.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fee of S$196.20 applies after the first year; ensure rewards earned justify the cost.
Interest rate is high at 27.80% p.a.; carrying a balance can lead to significant charges.
Late payment fee is S$100 if your outstanding balance exceeds S$200, so pay promptly.
